title: Shinonome Ena — The Emotions In The Art〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: Neighborhood
se_walk_women_001_1

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: *Sigh*

rows.Speaker: Yukihira
rows.Line: I have a proposal for you.

rows.Speaker: Yukihira
rows.Line: Next weekend, let's have a special lesson outside of class.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (A special lesson, huh...?)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (I was startled when Mr. Yukihira made that offer...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (But to think it'd be to help out at my dad's exhibit...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I mean, why his exhibit of all things...?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Do I really have to help...?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (Come to think of it, I used to do that a lot.)
A few years earlier

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Ena
rows.Line: Umm... The caption for this painting goes here and...

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Ena
rows.Line:
There.
I've finished doing everything I was asked to do.

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Ena
rows.Line: Hmm... But there's still some time before the exhibit opens.

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Ena
rows.Line: I think I'll take this chance to have a look around.
se_walk_women_005_1

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Ena
rows.Line: (Dad hardly ever teaches me anything himself, so I need to learn what I can by examining his paintings...)

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Ena
rows.Line: (Still, I wish he'd help me a little more since I'm also trying to become a professional artist...)

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Ena
rows.Line:
Oh, this painting...
I saw him working on it in his studio the other day...

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Ena
rows.Line: (Interesting... This is nothing like the sketch I saw... Did he change how he paints the surfaces of water and stuff...?)

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Ena
rows.Line: (The theme for this exhibit is “calmness”, so he might've changed things up to make sure it fits.)

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Ena
rows.Line: (But this is the only part that looks different...)

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Ena
rows.Line: (Oh, I get it now. He used his usual technique for the greenery but changed his approach for the water, making the water's surface stand out even more than the main subject.)

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Ena
rows.Line: (But I feel like there's more to this painting. Why are my eyes so drawn to it...?)

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Ena
rows.Line: (Is it the colors he used? The way he framed it...?)

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Ena
rows.Line: In any case, it's really amazing.

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Ena
rows.Line: (I hope I can paint like this someday.)

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Ena
rows.Line: (I'm going to become a famous artist just like Dad, and have my art be seen by lots of people...)

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Ena
rows.Line: (After all, I am his daughter, so I'm sure—)

rows.Speaker: Exhibit Staff Member
rows.Line: Excuse me, are you by chance Mr. Shinonome's daughter?

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Ena
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Exhibit Staff Member
rows.Line:
Oh, sorry for popping out of nowhere.
I heard that his daughter's in junior high and would be helping out today. You seemed to fit the bill.

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Ena
rows.Line: Oh, um... Yes, I'm Ena Shinonome.

rows.Speaker: Exhibit Staff Member
rows.Line:
Hehe. Nice to meet you.
It's so sweet of you to help with your father's exhibit.

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Ena
rows.Line:
I'm here because I also like to paint.
So I'm here to learn as much as I can.

rows.Speaker: Exhibit Staff Member
rows.Line:
Really? That's so admirable!
You seemed so focused just now when you were looking at that painting...

rows.Speaker: Exhibit Staff Member
rows.Line: I'm sure you'll also become a famous artist just like your father. I'll be rooting for you.

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Ena
rows.Line: Yes, I promise to become one!
se_walk_men_002_1

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Ena
rows.Line: (Yeah. Dad's been able to make it big like this...)

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Ena
rows.Line: (There's no way I'm not going to also become a famous artist in the future.)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (I was so naive...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Also, am I gonna have to tell him about that when I go to help out with his exhibit...?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (I feel like that's gonna be so awkward since we hardly talk to each other as it is...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (It's not like I have to tell him anyway...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (Now I'm starting to wonder what I should and shouldn't say.)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Is there even any point to this special lesson...?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (I honestly don't know what Mr. Yukihira's thinking, but...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: For now, I should go...
